2 Tablespoons Canola Oil
1 teaspoon Vanilla
description: Not only are these muffins gluten-free and healthy, but they are moist and delicious!

name: Green Tomato Panzanella Salad with Cilantro Lime Dressing
ingredients:
2 teaspoons FOR THE SALAD:
6 cups Olive Oil
3 whole Cubed Bread
¾ cups Salt And Pepper
1 whole Green Tomatoes, Medium Diced
¼ cups Corn Kernels
¾ cups Avocado, Medium Diced
¾ cups Onion, Small, Diced
¾ cups Red Pepper, Medium Diced
½ cups Green Pepper, Medium Diced
1 clove Queso Fresco, Crumbled
½ teaspoons Jalapeno, Small Diced, To Taste
1 Tablespoon FOR THE CILANTRO LIME DRESSING:
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
¼ cups Garlic, Roughly Chopped
½ teaspoons Dijon Mustard
¼ teaspoons Shallot (roughly Chopped)
description: Panzanella salad with a Southwestern twist!

name: Strawberry Lemonade Paletas
ingredients:
½ cups Fresh Lemon Juice
½ cups Sugar
¼ cups Light Corn Syrup
2-½ cups Puréed Strawberries
description: Sweet and refreshing summer strawberry and lemon juice popsicles.

name: Gooseberry Chutney
ingredients:
3-⅝ ounces, weight Gooseberry
¼ teaspoons Fenugreek Seeds
1 teaspoon Whole Black Pepper Corns
¼ cups Freshly Grated Coconut
description: The Gooseberry (amla/nellikai) Chutney recipe also known as Thogayal in south India, is a simple preparation of the wonder-berry “gooseberry”. Gooseberries are rich in antioxidants and vitamins and help in curing a variety of diseases. Furthermore, gooseberries contain adequate levels of minerals such as copper, calcium, phosphorus, manganese, magnesium and potassium.

name: Blueberry Mint Iced Tea
ingredients:
2  Family-sized Iced Tea Bags
1-¼ cup Sugar
1-½ cup Water
3 Tablespoons Fresh Mint Leaves
½ cups Fresh Blueberries
description: With just enough sweetness, Blueberry Mint Iced Tea is perfect for an evening of porch-sitting and conversation or for serving at any summer party.

name: Shrimp with Parmesan Grits and Tasso Cream Sauce
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE GRITS:
2 cups Instant Grits
2 cups Water
6 Tablespoons Milk
1 cup Salt And Pepper, to taste
1 Tablespoon Butter
1 Tablespoon Shredded Parmesan Cheese
1 cup FOR THE SHRIMP:
¼ cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil
¼ cups Butter
2 cloves Diced Tasso (or You Can Use Any Other Spiced Ham, Or Plain Ham With A Few Shakes Of Creole Seasoning)
1 pound Diced Bell Pepper
½ cups Diced Onion
1 cup Garlic, Minced
2 whole Shrimp, Medium To Large, Peeled And Deveined
description: I grew up above the Mason-Dixon line, so I wasn’t introduced to grits until I was 19 and driving through NC on my way to FL. I asked my father why someone put wall paper paste on my breakfast plate. Fast forward almost 20 years.  It took a ton of research, trial and error and marrying a southern boy to actually create a grits recipe I want to eat. Butter and Parmesan fix everything!

name: French Press Iced Coffee
ingredients:
½ cups Ground Coffee (I Use Dunkin' Donuts Brand)
3 cups Cold Water
1 cup Half-and-half
4 Tablespoons Or Less Of Vanilla Syrup (like Torani's), Or Your Favorite Flavoring
description: Cold-brewed coffee makes the best iced coffee. The long prep time is simply brewing time, so don’t let it scare you! It’s easy to leave it overnight on your counter and then have amazing iced coffee in the morning.

name: Braised Red Cabbage with Apples
ingredients:
½ heads Red Cabbage, Thinly Sliced
½ whole Onion, Thinly Sliced
2 Tablespoons Apple Cider Vinegar
1 Tablespoon Sugar
¼ teaspoons Allspice
1 whole Salt To Taste
description: Vegan and vegetarian, too!

name: Buttermilk Cake with Cherries and Walnuts
ingredients:
1 cup All-purpose Flour
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Salt
⅓ cups Olive Oil
½ cups Buttermilk, Room Temperature
½ cups Plus 1 Teaspoon Sugar, Divided Use
½ teaspoons Vanilla Extract
1 whole Egg, Room Temperature
1 cup Pitted Fresh Cherries, Halved
½ cups Chopped Walnut
description: Buttermilk cake with cherries and walnuts.

name: Lobster Bisque
ingredients:
4 whole Lobsters, Broken Down, Meat Harvested
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1 whole White Onion, Chopped
4 stalks Celery, Chopped
2 whole Carrots, Chopped
2 cloves Garlic, Chopped
2 Tablespoons Tomato Paste
4 cups Salt And Pepper, to taste
½ cups Lobster Broth
4 sprigs Heavy Cream Whipping Cream
description: Very simple and rewarding bisque with only a few ingredients.

name: Perfect Grilling Marinade
ingredients:
⅓ cups Low Sodium Soy Sauce
⅓ cups Lime Juice
2 Tablespoons Vegetable Oil
½ teaspoons Black Pepper
¼ teaspoons Ground Ginger
¼ teaspoons Red Pepper Flakes
2 cloves Garlic, Sliced
4  Green Onions, Chopped
description: This marinade combines the flavors of Asian cuisine with the classic American grill. While I used it for chicken and pork, you can marinade shrimp and beef in this same marinade with amazing results. Simply grill until the proper internal temperature for your meat is reached and enjoy with a nice side of fresh summer vegetables.

name: Besan Ladoo
ingredients:
2 cups Gram Flour
4 Tablespoons Warm Milk
½ cups Ghee (clarified Butter)
1 cup Sugar
1 teaspoon Cardamom Powder
description: Gram flour ladoos with ghee and sugar.

name: Papaya Lime Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup Ripe Papaya
2 whole Limes, Zested And Juiced
½ cups Greek Yogurt
½ cups Milk
4 Tablespoons Honey Or Maple Syrup
description: Cool off during the hot summer months with these refreshing, naturally sweetened Papaya Lime Smoothies!

name: Vanilla Bean Meringue Kisses
ingredients:
6 whole Large Egg Whites, Room Temperature
1 teaspoon Cream Of Tartar
¾ teaspoons Vanilla Bean Paste
1 pinch Fine Salt
1 cup Superfine Sugar
description: The next time you find yourself with leftover egg whites, make a batch of Meringue Kisses. They’re completely addictive, crispy, sweet little pillows of air that melt in your mouth. Don’t say I didn’t warn you!

name: Mediterranean Couscous Salad
ingredients:
1-¼ cup FOR THE SALAD:
1 cup Water
½ cups Uncooked Whole Wheat Couscous
1-½ cup Red Onion, Diced
1-½ cup Cucumber, Chopped
¾ cups Tomatoes, Chopped
3 Tablespoons Reduced-fat Feta Cheese
3 Tablespoons Italian Seasoning
1 teaspoon Fresh Basil, Sliced
¼ cups Garlic Powder
4 teaspoons Salt/pepper To Taste
2 Tablespoons FOR THE DRESSING:
2 Tablespoons White Wine Vinegar
description: A quick, easy and healthy salad that is always a crowd pleaser! It makes great leftovers too!

name: BBQ Chicken Burger
ingredients:
1 pound Ground Chicken Breast
1 teaspoon Garlic Powder
½ teaspoons Black Pepper
½ teaspoons Salt
¼ cups Favorite Barbecue Sauce Plus More For Serving
2 ounces, weight Sharp Cheddar Cheese, Diced Into 1/4" Cubes
4 whole Whole Wheat Hamburger Buns
1 cup Homemade Coleslaw (your Favorite Recipe Or See Mine On Related Blog Link)
description: A nice change from a typical beef patty. These moist chicken burgers are lower in fat but not in flavor! Delicious!

name: Mixed Berry Bircher Muesli
ingredients:
3-½ ounces, weight Porridge Oats
3-½ ounces, fluid Cranberry Juice
1 Tablespoon Honey
1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice
1 cup Natural Yogurt
3 ounces, weight Mixed Nuts, Chopped (I Used Brazils, Pecans, Walnuts And Almonds)
3-½ ounces, weight Raspberries
description: Bircher Muesli is one of my all time favorite breakfast recipes. I discovered it when I lived in Switzerland and ate it most mornings. I’ve even eaten it at the home where it was invented in Zurich! It’s super healthy and full of oats, nuts, yoghurt and fruit! It really fills you up and keeps you going until lunchtime.

name: Thai Noodle Soup
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Sesame Oil
7 ounces, weight Thinly Sliced Chicken Breasts Or Prawns (peeled And Deveined)
2 teaspoons Red Thai Curry Paste (add An Extra Tsp If You Prefer A Spicier Dish)
1 whole Red Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed, Sliced
6 whole Scallions, Sliced
16 ounces, fluid Chicken Stock
2 Tablespoons Fish Sauce
1 Tablespoon Low Sodium Soy Sauce
1 Tablespoon Lime Juice
1 teaspoon Ground Ginger
½ cups Frozen Edamame
5 ounces, weight Egg Noodles
2 Tablespoons Crushed Unsalted Peanuts, To Garnish
1 bunch Chopped Cilantro To Garnish
description: This is my ultimate ‘go-to’ dish when I feel like cooking Thai food. Sometimes curries can be a bit too rich and creamy for me, so this soup is a deliciously light way to keep all of those umami flavours, without breaking the calorie bank.

name: Banana Foster Bread Pudding
ingredients:
½ jars Caramel Sauce, 16 Ounce Jar
2 whole Bananas, Peeled And Sliced
1 loaf Store Bought Walnut/Raisin Bread, Crusts Removed, Cubed.
6 ounces, weight Low Fat Cream Cheese - Cubed
6 whole Eggs
1 cup Almond Milk (or Cows Milk)
½ cups Sugar
1-½ teaspoon Vanilla Extract
¾ teaspoons Cinnamon
1 pinch Nutmeg
1 pinch Salt
description: Served as a dessert or a brunch dish, this delicious tray of gooey caramel sweetness will disappear either way. Ignore your diet for a few moments to savor this dish, it is 100% worth it. It’s definitely the dish to surprise friends with at a gathering, or make for a large family get together. The only problem is, they might ask you to make it every time you meet!

name: Tomato, Basil and Mozzarella Salad
ingredients:
12 whole Heirloom And Cherry Tomatoes, Sliced
3-½ ounces, weight Fresh Mozzarella, Torn
8 whole Kalamata Olives
6 leaves Basil, Torn
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1 Tablespoon Balsamic Vinegar
1 pinch Salt And Pepper
description: It was the first properly warm evening of the spring, so all I craved was a light, fresh, colorful salad for dinner.  If you can get hold of them, use heirloom tomatoes for this dish as the colours brighten the dish up. Plus they taste so delicious!

name: Tequila Tiger Shrimp with Tangerine Dressing
ingredients:
4 Tablespoons FOR MY HOMEMADE RUB:
2 Tablespoons Kosher Salt
2 Tablespoons White Granulated Sugar
2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar
2 Tablespoons California Mild Chili Powder
1 Tablespoon Paprika
1 Tablespoon Ground Cumin
½ teaspoons Black Pepper
1 pound Cayenne Pepper (Optional)
2 teaspoons FOR THE SHRIMP:
3 Tablespoons Large Shrimp (I Used Tiger Shrimp, About 24 Per Pound)
2 Tablespoons Homemade Rub (Recipe Included) Or Salt And Pepper
¾ cups Chopped Mint (Chop It Just Before Using), Divided
2 cups Canola Oil
1 whole Good Tequila (I Used Patron), Divided
¼ cups Your Favorite Blend Of Mixed Greens
2 Tablespoons Fuji Apple (cored Then Sliced In Sticks For Garnish)
1 Tablespoon FOR THE TANGERINE DRESSING:
1 pinch Fresh Tangerine Juice Or Citrus Of Your Choice
description: I figured that since tequila is rumored to make your clothes fall off, it would also take shrimp shells off! Dangit, it didn’t work but I ended up with some tasty drunken grilled shrimp. Grilled shrimp is a great addition when you are in the mood for a healthy salad. For a crowd-pleasing appetizer version, use more shrimp and fewer greens.

name: Zucchini Meat Lasagna
ingredients:
1 pound Ground Beef, Lean
¼ cups Onions, Diced Small
½ Tablespoons Garlic, Minced
8 ounces, weight Portobello Mushrooms (Small), Sliced
1 cup Chicken Broth, Low-Sodium
24 ounces, weight Jar Pasta Sauce (I Used Roasted Red Pepper)
5 cups Sliced Zucchini, Sliced About 1/4" Thick
2 cups Spinach, Fresh
1-¾ cup Ricotta Cheese, Fat Free
¾ cups Mozzarella Cheese, Shredded, Low-fat
description: A thick, hearty noodle-less lasagna made with zucchini, ground beef and lots of cheese. A perfect low-calorie, low-carb pasta dish.

name: Sloppy Joe Sandwiches
ingredients:
1 pound Ground Beef Chuck
1 whole Medium Sized Onion, Diced
4 cloves Garlic, Minced
1-½ Tablespoon Pickled Jalapeños, Diced
1 whole Red Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed, Diced
2 teaspoons Pickled Jalapeno Juice
1 can (15  Oz. Size) Tomato Sauce
2 Tablespoons Tomato Paste
1 Tablespoon Red Wine Vinegar
1 Tablespoon Molasses
1 Tablespoon Worcestershire Sauce
1 teaspoon Mustard Powder
1 Tablespoon Prepared Mustard
1 package Salt And Pepper, to taste
description: This Sloppy Joe recipe makes some of the best Sloppy Joe sandwiches we have ever eaten. I used pita bread for the recipe because it is what I had on hand, but these are so bun-worthy!

name: Meaty Lasagna Roll-Ups
ingredients:
1 pound FOR THE LASAGNA ROLLS:
½ pounds Lasagna Noodles
½ pounds Canola And Herb Infused Olive Oil, For Browning
½ pounds Ground Beef
4 ounces, weight Ground Pork
1 pinch Ground Veal
1 Tablespoon Cremini Mushrooms, Finely Chopped
24 ounces, weight Salt (for Seasoning)
½ cups Worcestershire Sauce
2 whole Ricotta Cheese
¼ teaspoons Freshly Grated Parmesan Cheese
1 Tablespoon Eggs, Lightly Beaten
6 ounces, weight Nutmeg
3 cups Roughly Chopped Fresh Parsley
8 ounces, weight Additional Salt, To Taste
description: Delectable little meaty lasagna roll ups that can be made ahead for perfect entertaining. They are so savory, creamy, cheesy and amazing!

name: Chocolate Strawberry Shortcake
ingredients:
3-¾ cups FOR THE SHORTCAKE:
2 Tablespoons All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
½ cups Salt
½ cups Sugar
10 Tablespoons Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
2 whole Butter, Cold And Cut Into Cubes
1 cup Eggs
1 pound Milk (cold)
⅓ cups FOR THE STRAWBERRIES:
1 pint Fresh Strawberries, Plus 3 Additional For Garnish
2-½ Tablespoons Granulated Sugar
½ teaspoons FOR THE WHIPPED CREAM:
description: Decadent, but still light and summery. Fresh, in season strawberries and homemade whipped cream make this chocolate strawberry shortcake a sure hit for your next gathering!

name: Green Onion and Yogurt Grits
ingredients:
4 cups Beef Broth
1 cup Yellow Corn Meal
½ cups Greek Yogurt
1 bunch Whole Green Onions, Chopped
description: Twist on the classic creamy grits with cheese. I wanted the flavour of sour cream and onion, but used yogurt for the nutrition and calories. These have the same creamy consistency as creamy cheesy grits and green onion for a bit a zest. Great for a Latin-style dish. I topped mine with braised beef ribs and fresh salsa.

name: Vanilla Bean Lemonade
ingredients:
2 cups FOR THE SIMPLE SYRUP:
1 cup Water
1 whole Granulated Sugar
1  Vanilla Bean
1-¼ cup Lemon
2 cups FOR THE LEMONADE:
4 cups Fresh Lemon Juice (for 1 1/4 Cup You'll Need Roughly 6 Lemons)
2 cups Vanilla Bean & Lemon Simple Syrup
description: Vanilla Bean Lemonade—a delicious twist on a traditional lemonade with the addition of the vanilla.

name: Blended Coconut Mocha
ingredients:
⅛ cups Shredded Coconut For Toasting
1 cup Brewed Coffee, Cold
¼ cups Milk Or Half-and-Half
1 Tablespoon Vanilla Syrup
1 teaspoon Cocoa Powder
½ teaspoons Coconut Extract
7 whole Ice Cubes
description: Bold coffee, chocolate and coconut come together to make a super-refreshing ice cold pick-me-up! Perfect for summer!

name: Sweet Potato and Apple Bake
ingredients:
2 whole Large Sweet Potatoes, Peeled And Cut Into Cubes (peeling Is Optional)
2 whole Large Apples (I Used Gala), Peeled, Cored And Cut Into Cubes (peeling Is Optional)
1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 Tablespoon Butter
2 Tablespoons Honey
1 teaspoon Garlic Powder
2 teaspoons Cinnamon
description: Indulge in this sweet side dish of sweet potatoes and apples coated with a honey and cinnamon glaze and baked to tender perfection!

name: Vegan “Orange Julius” Smoothie
ingredients:
1-½ cup Fresh Squeezed Orange Juice
2 whole Ripe Bananas, Peeled And Frozen
1 teaspoon Fresh Orange Zest
¾ cups Unsweetened Almond Milk
¾ teaspoons Pure Vanilla Extract
4 cubes Ice, Or More To Taste
1 Tablespoon Agave (optional)
description: This tart-sweet smoothie has all the Orange Julius flavors you love without any added sugar or artificial ingredients!

name: Wieners Mac and Cheese
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Tomato Paste
½ cups Water
1  Medium Carrot, Coarsely Grated
2  Medium Onions, Diced
3  Wieners (hot Dogs)
1 bunch Dill, Shredded
½ teaspoons Salt
⅓ teaspoons Nutmeg
¼ teaspoons Ground Black Pepper
1-½ ounce, weight Butter
2  Eggs
1 pound Elbow Macaroni (cooked According To Package Instructions For Al Dente Then Drained)
7 ounces, weight Gouda Cheese (coarsely Grated)
description: Mac and cheese with hot dogs, eggs and tomato sauce.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients:
3  Large Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts
28 ounces, weight Canned Diced Tomatoes And Green Chile Peppers (like Rotel)
15 ounces, weight Canned Black Beans, Rinsed And Drained (or 1 1/2  Cups Of Cooked Beans If Using Dried)
14 ounces, weight Canned Golden Hominy, Rinsed And Drained
10 ounces, fluid Canned Mild Enchilada Sauce
½  Medium Onion, Chopped
10 ounces, weight Package, Frozen Corn
14 ounces, fluid Chicken Or Vegetable Broth
2 cloves Garlic, Minced
1 teaspoon Cumin
1 teaspoon Chili Powder
1 teaspoon Salt
¼ teaspoons Black Pepper
1  Bay Leaf
2-½ teaspoons Dried Cilantro
1 cup Water (optional)
description: This one pot meal is quick, easy and versatile. If you’ve got some meat lovers over for dinner, then go ahead and throw in some extra chicken. Otherwise, try it sans chicken for a meatless meal that’s filled with hearty beans and veg and won’t make you sorry you left out a little poultry. The flavors are Texas-sized, and the fixin’s add just the right complements to the filling soup.

name: Chicken & Waffle Sliders
ingredients:

Simple to make but beautiful to serve, this marbled bread isn’t your usual banana bread made from overripe bananas. The layering of batters makes sure that each slice gets a healthy helping of chocolate and the use of Kahlúa throughout the batter gives an adult coffee flavored twist in this loaf. I try to use bananas that walk the edge between ripe (a day or two past freckled brown) and over ripe (completely black), but whatever bananas you use will work as I cook them first to help concentrate the banana flavor. You’ll note that I use bread flour in the batter, which gives a nice chew to the final product but if you don’t have any, feel free to substitute in the same amount of all-purpose flour, just keep in mind the banana bread will come out slightly softer and more cake-like.

Simple to make but beautiful to serve, this marbled bread isn’t your usual banana bread made from overripe bananas. The layering of batters makes sure that each slice gets a healthy helping of chocolate and the use of Kahlúa throughout the batter gives an adult coffee flavored twist in this loaf. I try to use bananas that walk the edge between ripe (a day or two past freckled brown) and over ripe (completely black), but whatever bananas you use will work as I cook them first to help concentrate the banana flavor. You’ll note that I use bread flour in the batter, which gives a nice chew to the final product but if you don’t have any, feel free to substitute in the same amount of all-purpose flour, just keep in mind the banana bread will come out slightly softer and more cake-like.

description: I really hate the term “zucchini pasta” which ruins an otherwise decent dish. I had discovered it’s existence in a cookbook by the fabulous Molly O’Neill called A Well-Seasoned Appetite, which I bought when it was first released in hardcover back in 1995. Molly had written one of my all time favorite cookbooks, the New York Cookbook, and in my post-college days as a bookseller at a tiny little independent bookstore in St. Louis, I hand sold numerous copies to customers. Her follow-up was less eclectic and less storydriven than the New York Cookbook but no less enlightening, organizing the chapters and recipes by season, something that was less common back then. I remembered making her zucchini pasta, totally confused as to why it was called that, back in my black and white checkered floored St. Louis one-bedroom apartment kitchen for an ex-boyfriend of mine. The boyfriend didn’t last, though this recipe did. I still don’t like the name though.

I really hate the term “zucchini pasta” which ruins an otherwise decent dish. I had discovered it’s existence in a cookbook by the fabulous Molly O’Neill called A Well-Seasoned Appetite, which I bought when it was first released in hardcover back in 1995. Molly had written one of my all time favorite cookbooks, the New York Cookbook, and in my post-college days as a bookseller at a tiny little independent bookstore in St. Louis, I hand sold numerous copies to customers. Her follow-up was less eclectic and less storydriven than the New York Cookbook but no less enlightening, organizing the chapters and recipes by season, something that was less common back then. I remembered making her zucchini pasta, totally confused as to why it was called that, back in my black and white checkered floored St. Louis one-bedroom apartment kitchen for an ex-boyfriend of mine. The boyfriend didn’t last, though this recipe did. I still don’t like the name though.

Every week they’re available, I pick up nearly a bucket of perfect-for-pickling kirby cucumbers from the Greenmarket for my cucumber-junkie family with the greatest intention of finally making good on this promise. And I never, ever do. It might be that the first couple times I tried, many years ago, my always-too-hot kitchen molded both jars, traumatizing me at the end of the jars’ incubation periods. It might be that because I live in NYC, when I want an insanely good sour pickle, I just go to  on Essex Street or track down some from . Like bagels, killer soup dumplings, or Halal cart street meat, amazing pickles are in a category of food you have to be extremely driven and possibly cuckoo to make at home in NYC. description: The hint of lavender is subtle in this jam but it gives a floral dimension that really works with the plum. You might be tempted to put more in, but don’t as you’ll err on the side of making it taste too soapy. Any fresh plum will do, but I’d recommend a red, purple or black plum like Santa Rosa or Friar as they work well with the lavender. The recipe may seem like it uses a lot of sugar, but that’s to offset the tartness of the plum skin. The best thing about this recipe is that plums have a lot of inate pectin in it. Pectin is what makes the jam jell and solidify. Every fruit is different so your results are going to vary in terms of how much you get, but keep in mind the less ripe the fruit, the more pectin and the more jam you’ll get. More ripe (or overripe fruit) and you’ll have to cook the jam down more to reduce it to get it set.

description: The hint of lavender is subtle in this jam but it gives a floral dimension that really works with the plum. You might be tempted to put more in, but don’t as you’ll err on the side of making it taste too soapy. Any fresh plum will do, but I’d recommend a red, purple or black plum like Santa Rosa or Friar as they work well with the lavender. The recipe may seem like it uses a lot of sugar, but that’s to offset the tartness of the plum skin. The best thing about this recipe is that plums have a lot of inate pectin in it. Pectin is what makes the jam jell and solidify. Every fruit is different so your results are going to vary in terms of how much you get, but keep in mind the less ripe the fruit, the more pectin and the more jam you’ll get. More ripe (or overripe fruit) and you’ll have to cook the jam down more to reduce it to get it set.
ingredients:
3 1/2 lbs (1585 g) fresh plums
3 cups (600 g or 21 oz) white granulated sugar
1/2 cup (4 fl oz) fresh squeezed lemon juice
1 teaspoon lavender

description: Crumpets sound like something you only have with tea, in a stuffy room filled with doilies surrounded by people speaking Queen’s English. But I became slightly obsessed with them with a trip to Seattle years ago, when I was told to get them at a specialty shop in Pike’s Place. Somehow it never occurred to me to learn how to make a crumpet at home until recently, when I went through a crazy jamming and preserving phase (where I need a vehicle to eat said jam and preserves). Similar to an English muffin, the crumpet has more chew to it and isn’t quite as dry or craggily. In fact, for me, a good crumpet should be moist and chewy and full of holes so the butter and jam can soak into it. These particular homemade crumpets aren’t full of holes, but that’s probably because I don’t have the patience to cook them properly (traditionally you don’t flip them when you cook them which produces more holes). That’s OK. I also cut them in half (something most British people adamantly are against) to put the jam on two halves. Call me a terrible bastard American, I’ve given instructions on how to create a crumpet with lots of holes in it, but feel free to bastardize your crumpet like I have and flip away.

description: Crumpets sound like something you only have with tea, in a stuffy room filled with doilies surrounded by people speaking Queen’s English. But I became slightly obsessed with them with a trip to Seattle years ago, when I was told to get them at a specialty shop in Pike’s Place. Somehow it never occurred to me to learn how to make a crumpet at home until recently, when I went through a crazy jamming and preserving phase (where I need a vehicle to eat said jam and preserves). Similar to an English muffin, the crumpet has more chew to it and isn’t quite as dry or craggily. In fact, for me, a good crumpet should be moist and chewy and full of holes so the butter and jam can soak into it. These particular homemade crumpets aren’t full of holes, but that’s probably because I don’t have the patience to cook them properly (traditionally you don’t flip them when you cook them which produces more holes). That’s OK. I also cut them in half (something most British people adamantly are against) to put the jam on two halves. Call me a terrible bastard American, I’ve given instructions on how to create a crumpet with lots of holes in it, but feel free to bastardize your crumpet like I have and flip away.

description: It’s been a little quiet around here this week and I bet you already know why: moving out is the easy part! Moving in, hoo boy. You walk into an empty  with freshly painted walls and there’s nothing but possibility. You run from room to room, whee! Then your stuff arrives and the pristine landscape is forever compromised. The first boxes aren’t so bad: you prioritize bedding, toilet paper, toothbrushes and whiskey (um, just play along here.) The next few boxes are pretty doable too: glasses go where they always have, books go in bookcases and lamps go on tables. But then, eventually, you get down to the last six boxes and you look around and you realize that the closets, cabinets, dressers and shelves are all full so where does this go? Then, if you’re us, the great unraveling begins: how did we get to a place where we had so much stuff? I thought we were going to resist the siren call of consumption (says she who just purchased what can only be considered a luxury ice cube tray). How did I get to a place in my life where I had 125 cookie cutters, 9 shades of sanding sugar and cupcake wrappers in at least 7 patterns that I can neither bring myself to throw away or justify the space they will take up? The last 6 boxes take  to unpack; you’ll be glad you prioritized the whiskey.

description: The neglected bialy is getting it’s heyday recently with appearances in places outside their usual NYC residence like San Francisco’s Wise Son’s Deli as well as showing up on articles about new restaurant food trends. But a bialy isn’t just a bagel with some onions thrown into it, it’s a delicious creature all it’s own. With a center depression (but no hole) and a direct bake in the oven (without boiling them first like you do with bagels), bialys make a great savory breakfast or pretty much any time of day snack option. Traditionalists will probably quibble with the poppy and sesame seeds and be slightly horrified that I add a dash of black pepper as well, but the biggest egregious deviation from tradition in my recipe is probably that I use a little white whole wheat in the mix. Feel free to use regular all purpose instead but I wanted to give my bialy a little more bite of flavor, thus the whole wheat.

Caught up in a moment where I forgot that I am me and not, say, Ina Garten, I suggested he come over and I’d  lunch for us instead. I realized I’d lost my ever-loving mind. Sure, I’d  to be the kind of person who makes “just lunch, nothing fancy!” for friends on a whim but I am not. I don’t really do “whim” cooking, as a website with nearly 918 intricately detailed recipes in its archives might evidence. Plus, I had so many recipes I was overdue to test out — a lemonade, a , a tart and I’d been promising my son I’d make  for weeks, not to mention the daily grind of breakfast,  and dinner — that I felt like I had no time to cook anything extra.

description: I  by expressing, in no uncertain terms, just how terrible New York City summers really are — sticky airlessness occasionally broken up by eerily refreshing droplets of cool water on your head that turn out to be filthy window a/c run-off, and you know, given that NYC lets people with absolutely no relevant skills install their own window a/c units, you might not want to walk underneath them at all, is all I’m saying. description: Given my druthers, a word I’ve been looking for an excuse to type in a sentence for at least eight years, I would never choose a salad with lettuce in it over one that’s mostly shaved or shredded raw vegetables. I mean, lettuce — the dewy, freshly-plucked-from-the-earth stuff that spends a couple months a year gracing local farmer’s markets — can be absolutely delicious, but nine times out of ten, the same word is used to refer to that packaged stuff that doesn’t taste like a whole lot. And can we talk for just a second about that prematurely rotten red leaf that no bag of mesclun is ever without? Clearly I have spent an unnatural amount of time thinking about this. But in a world filled with , , , carrot salads with  or , ,  and * I’ve found little reason to worship solely at the salad altar of baby field greens.

name: My Mother's Famous Chinese Egg Rolls
ingredients:
50 Spring/Egg Roll Wrappers (about 2 packages), defrosted unopened at room temperature for 45 minutes or in the refrigerator overnight
1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with ¼ cup of cool water to seal egg roll
Cooking oil, for frying
FOR THE PORK
1 pound ground pork
1 tablespoon soy sauce
1 teaspoon cornstarch
FOR THE VEGETABLES
2 cloves garlic, very finely minced
½ head of cabbage (about 11 ounces)
3 carrots
1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger
10 fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded
1 tablespoon Chinese rice wine (or dry sherry)
1 1/2 tablespoons soy sauce
1/4 teaspoon sugar
1 teaspoon sesame oil
Freshly ground black pepper
2. To a food processor, add the shiitake mushrooms. Pulse a few times until the mushrooms are finely chopped. Insert shredder disk (large holes) and shred the cabbage and carrots.
3. Heat a wok or large saute pan over medium-high heat. Add just 1 tablespoon of cooking oil and swirl to coat. Add in the garlic and ginger and quickly stir-fry until fragrant. Add in the contents of the food processor (cabbage, carrots and shiitake). Turn heat to high and stir-fry for 1 minute until the vegetables are beginning to soften.
4. Use your tongs to make a large, empty spot in the middle of the pan (push the vegetables aside), swirl in an additional 1 teaspoon of cooking oil. When hot, add in the ground pork. Cook the ground pork in the middle of the pan until beginning to turn brown. Now use your tongs to mix the pork with the vegetables.
5. Add the rice wine, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and black pepper. Continue to stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes until the pork is cooked through.
6. Scoop out the filling to a baking sheet and spread out to cool. Prop up one end of the baking sheet slightly to allow excess the moisture to drain to one end. Let cool for 15 minutes and then discard all of the accumulated juices.
7. Now, you're ready to wrap (see photos for instructions on how to wrap). IMPORTANT: Only use 1 heaping tablespoon of filling for each egg roll. These are slender egg rolls, the width of the egg roll should only be 1.25" diameter. Keep the rolled egg rolls in neat, single layer and covered with plastic wrap to prevent drying. If you want to stack the egg rolls, make sure you have layer of parchment paper in between the layers to prevent sticking. Keep wrappers also covered with plastic wrap to prevent drying. Refrigerate up to 4 hours until ready to fry or freeze.
8. To fry the egg rolls, fill a wok or pot with 2 inches of high-heat cooking oil. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C) or until a cube of bread will fry to golden brown within 10 seconds. Gently slide in or lower the egg rolls, frying 4 to 6 at a time, turning occasionally until golden brown about 1½ minutes. Place on wire rack to drain and cool.
NOTE: To fry frozen egg rolls, do not defrost the egg rolls – just add them to the oil frozen, frying 4 to 6 at a time. Add an additional 1½ minutes to the frying time since they are frozen.
description: Authentic (but easy!) Chinese Egg Rolls Recipe from cookbook author Jaden Hair's mother.

The chorizo is an optional extra and could be substituted for mushrooms, walnuts, squash, courgette or anything you desire if you are a non meat-eater.

1-⅔ cup Unsalted Butter,  Room Temperature

name: Apple Fries Fritter-Style
ingredients:
1 whole Large Apple, Peeled, Cored And Cut Into Your Preferred French Fry Thickness

1 teaspoon Sugar

3 teaspoons Milk
description: If you have extra apples to use up, give this recipe a go! They are warm, crisp and sweet. A perfect fall treat.

name: Maple Pecan Chocolate Tartlets
ingredients:
½ cups FOR THE CRUST:
4 ounces, weight Unsalted Butter, melted
½ cups Cream Cheese, Softened
⅓ cups Packed Light Brown Sugar
1 cup Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
1 cup All-purpose Flour
2 Tablespoons FOR THE FILLING:
2 whole Packed Light Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon Unsalted Butter, melted
¼ cups Large Eggs
⅔ cups Vanilla Extract

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Banana Granola
ingredients:
¼ cups Brown Sugar (lightly Packed)
4 cups Rolled Oats
1 cup Coconut Chips (or Flaked Coconut)
1 cup Pecans, Roughly Chopped
¼ cups Unsweetened Cocoa Powder

3 Tablespoons Canola Oil (I've Also Used Coconut Oil)
3 Tablespoons Maple Syrup
½ teaspoons Salt
½ cups Peanut Butter Chips
description: Healthy chocolate peanut butter banana granola. Utterly delicious. I could not stop eating it!

name: Mac and Mushrooms in Lager Cheese Sauce
ingredients:
3 cups Shell Pasta (the Larger Shells)
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
2 cups Cremini Or Baby Bella Mushrooms, Sliced
1 Tablespoon Sea Salt And Ground Black Pepper To Taste
1 Tablespoon Butter (heaping Tablespoon)
1 cup All-purpose Flour
8 ounces, weight Milk
8 ounces, weight Smoked Gouda, Grated
⅓ cups Creamy Havarti, Grated
description: I thought my mac and cheese couldn’t get any better…and then I added beer.

name: Classic Meatloaf
ingredients:
1-½ pound FOR THE MEATLOAF:
1  Ground Beef
1  Egg
1 cup Onion, Chopped
1 cup Milk
⅓ cups Italian Bread Crumbs
2 Tablespoons Sea Salt And Ground Black Pepper To Taste
2 Tablespoons Butter, For Greasing Pan
description: Comfort food is widely recognized as a meal that takes us back to our youth; back when we were cared for and had no concerns whatsoever. Though, I’m pretty sure as kids we all moaned and groaned when we learned that the family was having meatloaf for dinner. I know I did, albeit I’m not sure why. Sure, meatloaf isn’t exactly pretty, but it tastes good!

name: Cream Puffs with Pumpkin Spice Whipped Cream
ingredients:
1 stick FOR THE PASTRY:
1 cup Unsalted Butter
½ teaspoons Water
1 teaspoon Salt
1 cup Sugar
4 whole All-purpose Flour
1 cup Eggs
¼ cups FOR THE WHIPPED CREAM:

2 Tablespoons Powdered Sugar
1 pinch Vanilla Extract
1 pinch Canned Pumpkin Puree
description: Flaky pastry filled with pumpkin-spiced whipped cream!

name: Caramel Apple-Pecan Streusel Pie
ingredients:
1-¼ cup FOR THE CRUST:
½ teaspoons All-purpose Flour
2 Tablespoons Salt
⅓ cups Granulated Sugar
4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, melted
6 Tablespoons Ice Water
1 cup FOR THE CARAMEL SAUCE:
⅓ cups Unsalted Butter
1 tub Packed Light Brown Sugar

1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract

2 Tablespoons Ground Cinnamon
¾ cups Cornstarch
⅔ cups Caramel Sauce
¼ cups Unsalted Butter, melted
6 Tablespoons FOR THE TOPPING:
¼ cups All-purpose Flour
description: A spin on the classic apple pie with gooey caramel, cinnamon apples and crunchy pecans.

name: Butternut Squash Penne with Pistachio Pesto
ingredients:
6 cups FOR THE PASTA:
2 Tablespoons Butternut Squash, Diced Into About1/2 Inch Cubes (1 Small Squash)
1 teaspoon Olive Oil

12 ounces, weight Pepper
1 cup Salt To Taste

⅓ cups FOR THE PISTACHIO PESTO:

⅛ teaspoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 pinch (Small) Garlic, Minced
description: This pasta is not only delicious and sure to be a family favorite, but it’s also so packed with nutrients that you’ll feel as if you have the power to save the world!

name: Salmon Sandwich with Tomato-Basil Chutney
ingredients:
1 pound FOR THE SALMON:
½ Tablespoons Salmon
½ Tablespoons Olive Oil
½ cups Salt And Pepper
28 ounces, fluid FOR THE CHUTNEY:
¼ cups Olive Oil
1-½ Tablespoon Yellow Onion, Chopped
2 Tablespoons Canned Whole Tomatoes
8 slices Finely Shredded Basil
1 cup Maple Syrup
2 ounces, weight FOR THE SANDWICH:
description: A salmon sandwich on toasty bread, topped with sweet tomato-basil chutney and creamy goat cheese.

name: Mini Pumpkin Cheesecakes with Gingersnap Crust
ingredients:
½ cups FOR THE CHEESECAKES:
8 ounces, weight Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese
2 Tablespoons Plain Cream Cheese, Room Temperature
½ cans Plain Greek Yogurt
2 whole Pumpkin Purée
⅓ cups Eggs
⅓ cups Light Brown Sugar
½ teaspoons Granulated White Sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
24 whole Pumpkin Pie Spice
1 cup Gingersnap Cookies
½ cups FOR THE WHIPPED CREAM:
1 teaspoon Heavy Whipping Cream
description: These individual treats are light, fluffy, and perfect for any fall party!

name: Sugar-Crusted Biscoff Pumpkin Bread
ingredients:
¾ cups Brown Sugar
½ cups Sugar

1 teaspoon Sugar
½ teaspoons Brown Sugar
description: A spice-filled pumpkin bread layered with Biscoff spread and topped with a cinnamon-sugar mix.

name: Meringue-Topped Chocolate Fudge Cake with Salted Caramel Sauce
ingredients:
¼ cups FOR THE CAKE:
2  Vegetable Oil
1 teaspoon Large Eggs
¾ cups Vanilla Extract
¾ cups White Sugar
1-¾ cup Light Brown Sugar
¼ cups All-purpose Flour

1 pinch Large Egg Whites
description: This is no ordinary chocolate fudge cake. It’s a showstopper! A rich, soft cake is perfectly complemented by sweet, glossy peaks of meringue and drizzled with gooey salted caramel sauce.

name: Orange Crush Cake
ingredients:
3 sticks Cake
3 cups Butter, Softened
5 whole Sugar
3 cups Eggs
½ teaspoons All-purpose Flour
1 cup Salt

1 Tablespoon Powdered Sugar (more If Needed), Sifted

description: Pretty much the same deliciousness as the original 7-UP pound cake, but with a hint of orange color and flavor.

name: Toasted Ciabatta with Shrimp and Tarragon Butter
ingredients:
½ pounds Shrimp, Peeled And Deveined
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil

1-¼ stick Unsalted Butter, At Room Temperature

1 loaf (16 Oz. Size) Ciabatta Bread, Cut In Half Horizontally
description: Warm toasted ciabatta bread topped with roasted shrimp and lemony tarragon-shallot butter.

name: Maple Sage Chicken Drumsticks
ingredients:
4 whole Chicken Drumsticks
4 Tablespoons Real Maple Syrup
1 Tablespoon Water
10 whole Sage Leaves
1 teaspoon Onion Powder
1 teaspoon Black Pepper
description: Fall food and cooking are back in full swing, and the flavors of maple and sage are two favorites of mine. The combination is even better, like on these chicken drumsticks slow cooked in the oven with fresh sage and real maple syrup. Served with a side of vegetables or mashed potatoes, it’s a winning dinner.

name: Cheddar Jalapeno Cornbread Muffins
ingredients:
1-¼ cup Cornmeal
½ cups All-purpose Flour
2 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar
1 Tablespoon Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Baking Soda
⅛ teaspoons Salt
1-½ cup Buttermilk
¼ cups Sour Cream
4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, melted
2 whole Large Eggs
½ cups Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese
2 Tablespoons Jalapeno Pepper, Minced
description: Tender and moist cornbread muffins dotted with fresh jalapenos and cheddar cheese.

name: Enyucado (Colombian Cassava Feta Pie)
ingredients:
400 grams FOR THE PIE:
120 grams Yucca (Cassava) Root
2 Tablespoons Panela
1 Tablespoon Shredded Unsweetened Coconut
1 teaspoon Butter
200 grams Anise
1 Tablespoon FOR THE CRUMB TOPPING:
1 Tablespoon Feta Cheese
1 Tablespoon Shredded Unsweetened Coconut
description: This is a traditional recipe for Enyucado. There are variants of this exotic pie all around Colombia. In some places, they add coconut milk to the dough, and in other places, the cheese is omitted. Either way, the result is a crispy, sweet and salty, delicious pie.

name: Slow Cooker Jalapeño Ranch Carnitas with Cilantro Lime Slaw
ingredients:
2 pounds FOR THE CARNITAS:
1 package Pork Loin
2 teaspoons (1 Oz. Size) Ranch Seasoning Mix
1 teaspoon Minced Garlic
1 whole Cumin
1 bottle Jalapeño, Sliced
3 cups (12 Oz. Size) Beer (I Used GF Redbridge)

8  Cumin
description: Pork loin is simmered all day, then shredded and broiled to crunchy, juicy perfection! Then it’s packed into a warm corn tortilla and topped with cilantro lime slaw! You’ve got to try this!

name: Italian Veggie Sliders with Whipped Feta Pesto Spread
ingredients:
2 whole Medium Zucchini, Thickly Sliced In Rounds

description: The ultimate vegetarian slider packed with fresh zucchini, mini sweet peppers, basil leaves and a creamy whipped pesto and feta spread!

name: Bulgur Salad with Chickpeas, Pomegranate Seeds and Almonds
ingredients:
1-½ cup Bulgur Wheat
1-¼ cup Water
¼ cups Fresh Lemon Juice

1 teaspoon Ground Cumin
½ teaspoons Ground Coriander
1 teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Freshly Ground Black Pepper
3 whole Green Onions, White And Greens Parts, Thinly Sliced
1 whole Red Jalapeno Or Serrano Chile, Seeded And Minced
1 clove Garlic, Minced
1 pound Fresh Chickpeas, Shelled (or Sub 1 Cup Thawed Frozen Green Chickpeas Or Canned Chickpeas, Drained And Rinsed For The Pound Of Fresh)
½ cups Pomegranate Seeds (or Arils)

½ cups Packed Fresh Mint Leaves, Chopped
½ cups Packed Fresh Flat-leaf Parsley Leaves, Chopped
description: This hearty and healthy salad is packed full of vitamins and nutrients. The perfect side dish!

name: Lavender Mascarpone Mini Cheesecakes
ingredients:
12 whole FOR THE CRUST:
2 Tablespoons Ginger Snap Cookies
¼ teaspoons Dark Brown Sugar

2 Tablespoons Nutmeg
½ pounds Butter, Melted
¼ cups FOR THE CHEESECAKE:

1 whole Cinnamon
1  Nutmeg
1 Tablespoon Egg
description: These lavender mascarpone mini cheesecakes are such an elegant dessert. A floral, rich cheesecake filling on a gorgeous spiced gingersnap crust!

name: Sweet Potato & Pumpkin Soup
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Butter
2  Onions, Chopped

36 grams Fresh Ginger, Grated

description: A hint of curry and a spicy chorizo garnish take this soup to the next level.

name: Margarita Chicken
ingredients:
8 whole FOR THE MARINADE:
16 ounces, fluid Chicken Drumsticks

description: Moist drumsticks marinated in a Bud Light Lime-a-Rita, lime, jalapeno, cilantro and garlic. Throw them on the grill for a wonderful quick meal.

name: Apple Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients:
¼ cups FOR THE DOUGH:
¼ cups Water, Warmed To 110 Degrees
1 package Granulated Sugar

description: These homemade apple cinnamon rolls are filled with sweet and tart apples and wrapped in a soft, fluffy package. Make these for breakfast anytime!

name: Vibrant Thai Green Curry Paste Recipe
ingredients:
1/2 cup of Thai basil
1 Bunch of fresh coriander, leaves & stems.
5-10 green Thai chilies (adjust to own tastes)

Large pinch of Himalayan rock salt
description: This bold curry paste is a far cry from the curry pastes you buy in a jar.The key to a vibrant and authentic Thai curry is to use fresh ingredients, as well...

name: Grilled Scallops Recipe
ingredients:
1 LB sea scallops
1 T fresh thyme
4 cloves of garlic, crushed
3 T olive oil
cracked pepper to taste
a pinch of salt
description: With a few sprigs of fresh thyme, crushed garlic, peppercorn and a sprinkle of sea salt, these scallops are just simply delicious!

name: Summery Garlic Salad Dressing
ingredients:
¼ cups Apple Cider Vinegar
¼ cups Olive Oil
1 clove Garlic, Finely Minced
1 teaspoon Mustard
1 teaspoon Honey
½ teaspoons Fresh Ground Pepper
description: I remember the first time I wasn’t forced to eat my vegetables: I was about 10 years old, and eating dinner at a friend’s house. Her parents served me a green bean dish, and I couldn’t offend her mother by not eating them. So I held my tongue and those beans went down the hatch! Now rarely a meal goes by where I don’t have a big serving of vegetables, and this fresh and light dressing is great on greens or even cooked lentils.

name: Cinnful Apple Bread
ingredients:
3 cups All-purpose Flour
4-½ teaspoons Baking Powder
1-½ teaspoon Sea Salt
2 teaspoons Ground Cinnamon
12 ounces, fluid Angry Orchard Cinnful Apple Hard Cider
2 cups Diced Apples
description: A delicious cinnamon apple bread made with hard cider! Just an awesome baked good for the chilly autumn weather. Also, very low in sugar!

¼ cups Soy Sauce
1 clove Garlic, Minced

4 pounds Pork Butt
description: My foolproof method for cooking fork-tender slow-roasted barbecue pork butt. Easy and tasty.

2-½ pounds Bartlett Pears, Peeled, Cored And Quartered

description: Pears, quinces, brown sugar and vanilla all cooked to a buttery, spreadable perfection in the slow cooker.

1 stick unsalted butter, softened

The few ingredients you might not have are pretty easy to get at a grocery store. Best of all, this recipe can be made in under an hour and still taste like you slaved for hours in the kitchen.
ingredients:

Beautiful Roasted Vegetables
ingredients:

Salt And Pepper, to taste

description: I was in the big city last week, and I decided about an hour into my errands that I was hungry. So I stopped at a lovely groc...

name: Roasted Yams & Sesame Seeds
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Canola Oil
2 Tablespoons Sweet Cream Butter, Melted
3 Tablespoons Honey
2 pinches Salt And Black Pepper
4 whole Yams (peeled, Cut Into Small Wedges)
2 Tablespoons Sesame Seeds
description: Great side dish to accompany any main course!

name: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients:
2 cups Chunked Butternut Squash (approximately 1" Pieces)
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1 Tablespoon Unsalted Butter
2 Tablespoons All-purpose Flour
4 cups Chicken Or Vegetable Stock (I Used Low Fat, Low Sodium)
1 whole Onion, Peeled And Quartered
1 whole Potato, Peeled And Quartered
1 Tablespoon Chopped Fresh Sage
description: Autumn comfort in a bowl!

name: Radishes on Buttered Baguette
ingredients:
1 whole Fresh Baguette
½ cups Butter, Softened
1 cup Radishes, Thinly Sliced
½ teaspoons Sea Salt (I Used Pyramid Sea Salt From Cyprus; You Could Also Use Fleur De Sel)
¼ cups Fresh Dill (optional)
description: Radishes are peppery little root veggies. In this simple recipe, I serve them sliced on buttered baguette with a sprinkle of coarse salt.

name: Pumpkin Spice Trail Mix
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Butter, Melted
1 Tablespoon Pumpkin Pie Spice
¼ cups Brown Sugar
½ cups Walnuts
3 cups Wheat Chex Cereal
1 cup Pretzels, Butter Flavored
1 cup Yogurt Covered Raisins
description: Smells like cinnamon sticks and fresh-baked pumpkin pie. Plus it’s a whole-grain snack!

name: Pumpkin Spice Baked Oatmeal with Blueberries
ingredients:
2 cups Old Fashioned Rolled Oats
¾ cups Light Or Dark Brown Sugar
¼ cups Ground Flaxseed
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
1 teaspoon Pumpkin Pie Spice
1 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon
¼ teaspoons Freshly-ground Nutmeg
¼ teaspoons Fine Sea Salt
¼ cups Sugar-free, All-natural Applesauce
¼ cups Pumpkin Puree
½ cups Unsweetened Almond Milk
1 whole Large Egg
2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, melted
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
¾ cups Fresh Blueberries
description: This baked oatmeal has a ton of fall flavor packed with pops of freshness from the blueberries!

name: Pumpkin Pecan Honey Butter
ingredients:
1 can (16 Oz. Size) Pumpkin Pie Filling
1-½ stick Sweet Cream Butter, Softened
3 Tablespoons Pure Honey
1-½ teaspoon Cinnamon
½ cups Chopped Pecan Pieces
description: Golly, this is so delicious and easy to prepare. It has so many uses. We love it on sweet rolls!

name: BLT Pizza – Bacon Lettuce and Tomato Pizza
ingredients:
8 strips Bacon
1 whole (Medium To Large Size) Pizza Crust
4 ounces, weight Chive And Onion Cream Cheese
1 bunch Romaine Lettuce, Shredded
½ pints Grape Tomatoes, Sliced In Half
1 dash Salt And Pepper
description: Taking the classic BLT sandwich and making a fun and fresh pizza.

name: Cape Cod Cocktail
ingredients:
4 ounces, fluid Cranberry Juice
1 ounce, fluid Vodka
1 slice Lime
description: Having just come back from road tripping through Cape Cod, I found out that one of my favourite drinks, the vodka cranberry, is also called a Cape Cod, or Cape Codder! The cape is riddled with cranberry bogs, so it is fitting that its namesake cocktail incorporates the juice of this ruby red fruit.

name: Mushroom Stuffed Potatoes
ingredients:
1 whole Baked Potato, Cooked
1 Tablespoon Unsalted Butter
½ cups Cooked And Shredded Beef
1 cup Renaissance Faire Style Mushrooms, Or Your Favorite Sauteed Mushrooms
½ Tablespoons Chopped Chives
description: Awesome Renaissance-Faire-style mushrooms and shredded beef loaded into a baked potato. Dinner just got better.

name: Dilly Lentil Salad
ingredients:
1 can (19 Oz. Or 540ml Size) Lentils, Drained Or Rinsed
½ cups Dried Cranberries
½ cups Vinaigrette (I Used My Summery Garlic Salad Dressing)
¼ whole Cucumber, Diced
2 whole Radishes, Diced
¼ cups Chopped Fresh Dill
¼ cups Chopped Fresh Mint
description: I love the different colours in this salad: the bright green dill, the magenta radishes, and the jewel-like cranberries. Refer to my Summery Garlic Salad Dressing to dress this salad—that is also quick and easy.

name: Lemon Lime Water
ingredients:
1 liter Fresh Water
1 whole Lemon, Scrubbed Clean
1 whole Lime, Scrubbed Clean
description: If you ever get tired of plain water (ooh how fancy you are, that fresh clean water is too boring), try flavouring it with fruit, vegetables and herbs. Here, we use slices of fresh lemon and lime. The resulting water is so refreshing and tangy, it makes a perfect libation for a hot summer day.

name: Lemon-Ginger Butter
ingredients:
1-½ stick Sweet Cream Butter, Softened
1 whole Lemon (washed, Zest And Juice)
2 Tablespoons Grated Ginger Root
1 Tablespoon Honey
description: This is so delicious on so many items!

name: Perfect Mashed Potatoes
ingredients:
3  Russet Potatoes, Peeled And Diced Into 1/2-inch Pieces
1-¼ Tablespoon Salt, Divided
4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, melted
½ cups Whole Milk
¼ cups Half-and-half
¼ teaspoons Ground Black Pepper
description: Creamy and fluffy, dreamy mashed potatoes—a perfect side dish.

name: Ruby Red Rhubarb and Strawberry Crumble
ingredients:
4 cups Rhubarb, Chopped Into 1-inch Pieces
4 cups Strawberries, Hulled And Cut Into Bite-sized Chunks
¾ cups Sugar
1 Tablespoon Cornstarch (up To Double This, If Desired)
1 cup Flour
1 cup Rolled Oats
¾ cups Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
¾ cups Butter Or Margarine

You can assemble this dish a day ahead and bake just before you want to serve it. It is wonderful hot from the oven and served with ice cream, or cold at a picnic! ¼ cups Granulated Sugar

¼ cups Eggs

name: Homemade Pumpkin Chai Latte
ingredients:
1 tea bag of spiced chai (or decaf spiced chai rooibos)
½ cup plain, unsweetened almond milk or milk of choice*
2 tablespoons real pumpkin purée
1 tablespoon real maple syrup or honey
¼ teaspoon vanilla extract
⅛ teaspoon cinnamon
⅛ teaspoon ground ginger
Dash nutmeg
Dash cloves
Tiny dash salt
½ teaspoon arrowroot starch or cornstarch (optional, makes the latte super creamy)
Optional garnishes: 1 cinnamon stick or star of anise, coconut whipped cream
1 can (14 ounces) full fat coconut milk, chilled at least 10 hours (the coconut milk MUST be full fat and MUST be refrigerated for at least 10 hours. Put a mixing bowl in the freezer to chill while you're at it.)
1 tablespoon maple syrup
½ teaspoon vanilla extract
⅛ teaspoon cinnamon
description: Pumpkin spice chai latte made with natural ingredients: pumpkin puree, almond milk, maple syrup and spices. This creamy yet skinny latte clocks in at only 90 calories (without the totally optional coconut cream). Amounts listed below yield one latte so multiple up as necessary. If you want to save some time, I think you could use about ½ teaspoon pumpkin pie spice instead of the spices listed below. I think you could also make a big batch of this, store it in the refrigerator and rewarm individual drinks on the stove (whisk well to recombine).

name: Pulled Pork Sandwich (Bahn Mi)
ingredients:
3 pounds Pork Butt Roast
2 Tablespoons Crushed Garlic
2 Tablespoons Oil
1  Large Onion
1 cup Sherry Wine, Divided
2  Carrots
1 cup Cider Vinegar, Divided
1 Tablespoon Sugar
½ cups Sliced Radish

1 bunch Cilantro
½ cups FOR THE CHILI MAYO:
½ cups Mayonnaise

name: Pumpkin Spice French Toast
ingredients:
2  Eggs
⅓ cups Milk
2 teaspoons Brown Sugar
2 Tablespoons Pumpkin Pie Spice
2 Tablespoons Butter
4 slices Fresh Italian Bread
description: Add an autumn flair to your breakfast with this wonderful pumpkin spice French toast!

name: Raspberry Crumb Bread with Lemon Glaze
ingredients:
½ cups FOR THE CRUMB TOPPING:
1-½ Tablespoon Flour
1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon Granulated Sugar
⅛ teaspoons Baking Powder
3 Tablespoons Salt
1-½ cup Butter, Melted
1-½ teaspoon FOR THE RASPBERRY LOAF:

¾ cups Salt
1  Butter, Melted

2 teaspoons Sour Cream

1 teaspoon FOR THE LEMON GLAZE:
1 teaspoon Confectioners Sugar
description: This recipe can be easily adapted for muffins, but I prefer baking it in a loaf pan and calling it “bread”. Raspberry bread suggests enjoying a slice in the middle of the afternoon, with a cup of coffee or tea.

name: Red Curry Coconut Squash Soup
ingredients:
1  Medium-sized Butternut Squash
2 Tablespoons Butter
1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil

3 cloves Garlic, Minced
1 Tablespoon Freshly Grated Ginger

14 ounces, fluid Coconut Milk
½ cups Skim Milk

name: Drumsticks with Sriracha and Honey Lime Sauce
ingredients:
2 pounds Chicken Drumsticks
1-½ Tablespoon Soy Sauce
1 Tablespoon Honey
1 teaspoon Sriracha

1 whole Lime, Zested

description: Grilled drumsticks tossed in a sweet and spicy Sriracha and honey lime sauce! A great addition to your game day line up!

name: Salmon Over Orzo Risotto
ingredients:
4 teaspoons Olive Oil
¼ cups Onion, Diced

1 teaspoon Pepper

name: Salted Caramel Apple Cinnamon Smoothie

ingredients:
2 cans (15 Oz. Size) Chickpeas (or Garbanzo Beans), Drained And Rinsed

name: Scalloped Potatoes in a Crockpot
ingredients:
6 whole Large Potatoes, Peeled, Thinly Sliced
1 whole Medium Onion, Peeled,thinly Sliced
4 Tablespoons Butter
¼ cups Plus 1 Tablespoon All-purpose Flour

⅛ teaspoons Pepper
2 cups Milk (I Used Non-fat)
2 Tablespoons Heavy Whipping Cream
1-⅓ cup Cheddar Cheese, Shredded
description: Thinly sliced potatoes layered with onions, covered in a creamy cheddar cheese sauce and slow-cooked in the crockpot.

name: Self-Rising Biscuits
ingredients:
2-⅓ cups Whole Milk
3 Tablespoons White Distilled Vinegar
6 cups Self-rising Flour, Plus More For Kneading
1-½ teaspoon Salt
¾ cups Lard (OR Butter OR Shortening OR A Combination)

name: Shrimp and Grits

2 cups Water (see Note)
2 cups Milk (see Note)

name: Slow Cooker White Bean Chicken Chili Verde
ingredients:
1 whole Small Onion Chopped

name: Colcannon Soup
ingredients:
2 teaspoons Olive Oil
3 slices Thick Cut Smoked Bacon, Diced
2 whole Leeks -- Well Cleaned And Sliced (white And Light Green Only)
4 cups Chicken Broth, Low-Sodium

name: Soft and Fudgy Chocolate Cake with Chocolate Frosting
ingredients:
1-¾ cup FOR THE CAKE:

1 stick Lightly Salted Butter (softened)

name: Spinach and Mushroom Quiche

1  Pie Crust (or Pie Shell), Chilled

⅓ cups Ricotta

2 cups FOR THE STIR-FRY:

description: One of my secret food shames is that I don’t love spicy foods as much as would probably make me cool these days. I’ve got no Thai chile-eating bravado, no Sichuan peppercorn count to throw around, and I never even once in college went to one of those Buffalo wings places where they make you sign a waiver (such as the delightfully named, late Cluck U Chicken near Rutgers University) and lived to brag about it, the way others might boast about how much they bench press or how fast they run a mile (nope, nothing to  about there either). My ideal hot sauce can’t be found among my husband’s collection of Tapatio, Cholula and Sriracha, but in this , one of the few little orange bottles that I feel really understands my appreciation of heat in food, but not so much that it overwhelms everything. I accept that this makes me culinarily a wuss.

description: What, you’ve never had cauliflower cheese before? Why, it’s right up there on the American Heart Association’s recommended diet, above the kale and below the oat bran. Okay, well, maybe just the cauliflower is. I realize this dish may sound strange if you’ve never heard of it. The first time I saw it on a menu in the UK , I thought a word was missing, perhaps “with” or “and.” I mean, you cannot make cheese out of cauliflower or vice-versa, or at least I hope not.* And then I tried it, bubbling and brown in a small ramekin aside my roast** at a tiny Inn in the middle of nowhere that looks like something you’d see in a Bridget Jones Diary (basically where I learned everything I knew about the UK before I got there, well, that and ) and I stopped talking. I stopped thinking. My heart may or may not have stopped beating for a moment, though I’m sure it was , not fibrillations. How could it be anything but, when cauliflower florets are draped with a sharp cheddar cheese sauce spiked with mustard and a bit of cayenne and then baked in the oven until bronzed and, wait, what were we talking about again?

description: These spiced pumpkin seeds are insanely easy to make and only take 5 minutes. So easy in fact, that you don’t have to wait for your parent’s or your significant other to make them. Since I don’t have a front porch I can proudly display my jack-o-lantern, I rarely carve my own pumpkins. So instead, I buy pepitas, raw pumpkin seeds, as the grocery store (you can find them in upscale or natural food grocery stores in the bulk bin, at specialty stores like Trader Joe’s or at Mexican grocery stores) then candy them on the stove top. Sweet and spicy with a nuttiness, these make great snacks and can even be packaged and given as an easy gift if you’re feeling all DIY. Feel free to substitute or even leave out the spices can be omitted if you just want candied pumpkin seeds or don’t really care for any of those specific spices.

Congo bars are chewy chocolate chip cookie bars, otherwise known as blondies, and are irresistible. I used a mix of semi-sweet, dark and extra dark chocolate but feel free to use whatever you have or like to eat. I also deepen the flavor by adding almond meal and browning the butter, something most recipes for congo bars don’t do. The almond meal adds a nutty moistness to the cookie bar recipe and the browned butter really gives the treat an extra fragrant dimension. I like to chop the chocolate I use because chocolate chips keep their shape and I like my chocolate gooey and melty when I bite into. But if you only have chocolate chips or are too lazy to chop the chocolate, by all means use the chips, they are perfectly acceptable. Every time I make these, people rave about them and reach for an extra one even if they say they are full. They’re that good.

If you use cold cream cheese the batter will be lumpy so plan accordingly or place the still foil wrapped cream cheese in warm water for a few minutes to help bring it up to room temperature.

These dense fudgy brownies with minty cheesecake swirled into them are a perfect balance of chocolate, mint and rich cheesecake. If you like your brownies super minty, consider adding an additional 1/2 teaspoon to the cheesecake batter but I prefer to have a more subtle mint so it doesn’t overpower the brownie. The secret to the balance of deep flavors is using the limited edition Kahlúa Peppermint Mocha in the brownie part. I used a little bit of food coloring in the cheesecake to get the red and green swirls but if you are food coloring adverse, skip that part as it’s purely decorative. If you can’t find the limited edition Kahlúa Peppermint Mocha, just use regular Kahlúa and add a 1/2 teaspoon of peppermint extract to the brownie mix instead. Note that the cheesecake batter calls for cream cheese at room temperature. If you use cold cream cheese the batter will be lumpy so plan accordingly or place the still foil wrapped cream cheese in warm water for a few minutes to help bring it up to room temperature.

description: Congo bars are chewy chocolate chip cookie bars, otherwise known as blondies, and are irresistible. I used a mix of semi-sweet, dark and extra dark chocolate but feel free to use whatever you have or like to eat. I also deepen the flavor by adding almond meal and browning the butter, something most recipes for congo bars don’t do. The almond meal adds a nutty moistness to the cookie bar recipe and the browned butter really gives the treat an extra fragrant dimension. I like to chop the chocolate I use because chocolate chips keep their shape and I like my chocolate gooey and melty when I bite into. But if you only have chocolate chips or are too lazy to chop the chocolate, by all means use the chips, they are perfectly acceptable. Every time I make these, people rave about them and reach for an extra one even if they say they are full. They’re that good.

Pretzel salt, coarse salt or sesame seeds
Thoroughly brush tops and creases between rolls (as best as your brush can get in) with the lye or soda pretzel wash. Rinse brush and beat your egg with 1 teaspoon water. Brush the rolls a second time, this time with the egg wash. Sprinkle rolls with either sesame seeds or coarse salt. 1/2-inch down (I always make my cuts too shallow and they get lost when baked).
description: There are kitchen discoveries that lead to nothing but trouble. The first time I , I knew I was ruined. Why would anyone want to eat drab white sugar if they could eat it cooked to a 100x as delicious toasty amber syrup? The first time I tried browned butter, I went on a butter-browning bender (! ! !) which, frankly, shows little sign of abating today. So, it should be no surprise that when I finally cracked the  six months ago, I didn’t know where to stop. Everything comes up pretzel now! I’ve made  and pretzel challahs. I’m dreaming of pretzel shortbread and popovers, pretzel bagels and grissini. I might need an intervention.

name: Creamy Vegan Pumpkin Soup

description: A buttery and slightly salty roll, filled with cheddar cheese. Only 124 calories per roll.

name: Cumin & Mustard Roasted Chicken with Fruit
ingredients:
1  Whole Organic Chicken, Backbone Removed, Cut Into 8 Pieces, Extra Skin And Fat Trimmed

1 Tablespoon Unsalted Butter

Thankfully, some quick thinking led me to serving this delicious Cumin & Mustard Roasted Chicken with Fruit!

I mean, I’m theoretically too old to be having tantrums, kitchen or other, but there’s no other way to describe this behavior where I get frustrated, throw my jangly measuring spoons in the sink and huff off to gaze at jeans I could probably fit half a thigh into, which is how I mope.* Sure, you could just say that I need a little space, a break, it’s-not-you-it’s-me from the recipe so I can gain some perspective, and consider other approaches but ? That is how long it’s been since I last attempted to share a recipe for old-school, dead-simple butterscotch pudding from scratch which refused to set. A six-year tantrum. description: Don’t be intimidated by this long list of ingredients, as this is easy spaghetti and meatball recipe is mostly “walk away” time with the sauce and meatballs cooking in the oven. The oven roasting concentrates the tomato sauce flavor and gives it a touch of roasting smokiness. Because tomatoes aren’t in season in the wintertime, I added a can of tomato paste to give it a little more flavor but if tomatoes are in season, taste the sauce first to see if you need the paste. You might not! The addition of fish sauce to the recipe is going to sound weird but trust me when I say that you don’t taste it at all. What you do get is a deeper umami savory flavor from the fish sauce. If you don’t have fish sauce, just skip that part but if you have some floating in the back of your fridge, pull it out and try it. You’ll be surprised at how much it adds to the tomato sauce.

Don’t be intimidated by this long list of ingredients, as this is easy spaghetti and meatball recipe is mostly “walk away” time with the sauce and meatballs cooking in the oven. The oven roasting concentrates the tomato sauce flavor and gives it a touch of roasting smokiness. Because tomatoes aren’t in season in the wintertime, I added a can of tomato paste to give it a little more flavor but if tomatoes are in season, taste the sauce first to see if you need the paste. You might not! The addition of fish sauce to the recipe is going to sound weird but trust me when I say that you don’t taste it at all. What you do get is a deeper umami savory flavor from the fish sauce. If you don’t have fish sauce, just skip that part but if you have some floating in the back of your fridge, pull it out and try it. You’ll be surprised at how much it adds to the tomato sauce.

I also use almond meal in this recipe, to add rich moisture and a subtle nuttiness to the muffin as well as protect the muffin from overmixing and becoming too heavy when they bake. If you don’t have almond meal, you can either grind a 1/3 cup of regular almonds in a blender or food processor until it is powder and use that in place or just skip the almond meal and use 1/4 cup all-purpose flour in place. No big deal. But if you have almond meal or flour around, use it. You’ll be surprised at what it the small amount adds to the muffin recipe.

zest of 1 medium blood orange

It’s also economical and you can tailor it to suit your taste by adding ginger, garlic, red pepper flakes, and other goodies. This doubles great!

This flavorful fried chicken is made with boneless thigh meat for extra juiciness. You can certainly use boneless breast meat if you want but expect it to be a little less juicy. There are a few ingredients that might be hard to find if you don’t have access to an Asian grocery store. The sweet potato starch (sometimes called yam starch or occasionally mislabeled sweet potato flour) is probably the hardest to find. Asian grocery stores as well as some Latin or Mexican grocery stores carry it. If you find a bag of sweet potato flour, take a look at the color of the powder beforehand. If it’s white and has the texture and feel of cornstarch, it’s probably the starch and that’s what you want in this recipe – squeeze the bag if you can and if it squeaks, then it’s starch. If it’s more yellow or orange and feels more like regular all-purpose flour (no squeak, more soft and puffy in feel), than you actually have sweet potato flour, which will impart the sweet potato flavor and won’t fry up as crisp. Avoid it for this recipe. If you can’t find sweet potato starch, try substituting regular potato starch in its place. I wouldn’t recommend cornstarch though, as it gets kind of dense when fried.

This flavorful fried chicken is made with boneless thigh meat for extra juiciness. You can certainly use boneless breast meat if you want but expect it to be a little less juicy. There are a few ingredients that might be hard to find if you don’t have access to an Asian grocery store. The sweet potato starch (sometimes called yam starch or occasionally mislabeled sweet potato flour) is probably the hardest to find. Asian grocery stores as well as some Latin or Mexican grocery stores carry it. If you find a bag of sweet potato flour, take a look at the color of the powder beforehand. If it’s white and has the texture and feel of cornstarch, it’s probably the starch and that’s what you want in this recipe – squeeze the bag if you can and if it squeaks, then it’s starch. If it’s more yellow or orange and feels more like regular all-purpose flour (no squeak, more soft and puffy in feel), than you actually have sweet potato flour, which will impart the sweet potato flavor and won’t fry up as crisp. Avoid it for this recipe. If you can’t find sweet potato starch, try substituting regular potato starch in its place. I wouldn’t recommend cornstarch though, as it gets kind of dense when fried.

1 whole Large Onion, Peeled And Thinly Sliced

name: No-Bake Peanut Butter Crunch Bars
ingredients:
1 cup Peanut Butter (crunchy Or Smooth But Not Natural)
½ cups Brown Sugar
½ cups Corn Syrup, Light Colored

name: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Apple Slaw
ingredients:
1  Small Onion, Diced

name: Whipped Garlic Hummus
ingredients:
1 can FOR THE HUMMUS:

12  Pepper

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
ingredients:
1 can (15 Oz. Size) Chickpeas, Undrained
1 can (15 Oz. Size) Chickpeas, Drained.
¾ cups Jarred Roasted Red Pepper, Or More To Taste (up To 1 Cup)

name: The Most Delicious Guacamole Ever!
ingredients:
3 whole Ripe Avocados, Peeled And Pitted
1 whole Onion, Diced
2 whole Medium Tomatoes, Diced
1 whole Jalapeno, Diced (if You Like It Extra Spicy, Leave The Seeds In)
2 cloves Garlic, Minced
1 bunch Cilantro, Roughly Chopped (use As Desired; I Used A Good Handful)

½ teaspoons Chili Powder, Or To Taste
¾ teaspoons Salt, Or To Taste
¾ ounces, fluid Freshly Ground Black Pepper, To Taste
1 whole Good Quality Tequila
description: This guacamole is the perfect combination of fresh vegetables, savory spices, refreshing citrus and one extra special secret ingredient.

name: Tortilla-Crusted Zucchini Fries with Spicy Red Pepper Dip
ingredients:
4 ounces, weight FOR THE DIP:
4 ounces, weight Hot And Spicy-style Peppers (Peppadew), Drained
2 Tablespoons Cream Cheese
2 whole Plain Greek Yogurt
¼ teaspoons Green Onions, Ends Trimmed, And Cut Into 2-inch Pieces
¼ teaspoons Salt
4 whole Ground Black Pepper
1 whole FOR THE ZUCCHII FRIES
1-½ cup Zucchini (small), Ends Trimmed
description: When snack time rolls around, break out Tortilla-Crusted Zucchini Fries with Spicy Red Pepper Dip. This tasty snack is easy to put together and delivers a little crunch and a little zing. These fries are actually baked, so they’re healthier than many other snack options. Score!

name: Cherry Do-Dads
ingredients:
1 cup Unsalted Butter, Softened
1-½ cup Granulated Sugar
3 whole Large Eggs
1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice
½ teaspoons Almond Flavouring
2 cups All-purpose Flour
½ teaspoons Salt
⅓ cans (21 Oz. Size) Cherry Pie Filling
description: Soft cherry almond cookies that are fast and easy and perfect for a Valentine’s Day treat!

name: Fettuccine with Mussels, Chorizo, and Lemon Butter
ingredients:
6 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, At Room Temperature
1 whole Lemon, Zested
¼ cups Fresh, Flat-leaf Parsley, Chopped
¼ teaspoons Kosher Salt
⅛ teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Divided
1 whole Shallot, Diced
2 pounds Mussels, Beards Trimmed And Cleaned
½ cups Dry White Wine
2 sprigs Fresh Thyme
1 pound Fettuccine Pasta
6 ounces, weight Chorizo Sausage, Skinned And Thinly Sliced
description: Fettuccine pasta tossed with white wine-steamed mussels, spicy chorizo, and lemon parsley butter, drizzled with chorizo oil.

name: Raspberry Basil Bourbon Spritzers
ingredients:
⅓ cups Raspberries (Fresh If You Have Them, But Frozen Is Fine Too), Plus Extra For Garnish
2 Tablespoons Chopped Fresh Basil, Plus Extra For Garnish
1 Tablespoon Sugar
¼ cups Bourbon
1 Tablespoon Lime Juice
½ cups Ice
½ cups Champagne, Or About 1/4 Cup To Top Off Each Glass
description: Dress up your drinks with these raspberry basil bourbon spritzers—perfect for Valentine’s Day! (Or, y’know, Tuesday).

name: Seafood Medley Fra Diavolo
ingredients:
24  Whole Clams
1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Might Require More If Pan Becomes Too Dry
½ pounds Large Uncooked Shrimp Peeled And Deveined
¾ pounds Large Scallops
6 cloves Garlic, Peeled And Minced
3  Shallots, Peeled And Chopped
35  Cherry Tomatoes
1-¾ cup Canned Crushed Tomatoes
1-½ cup Dry White Wine
1 Tablespoon Fresh Basil, Minced
1 Tablespoon Parsley, Minced, Plus A Bit For Garnish
½ teaspoons Dried Oregano
½ pounds Salt And Pepper, to taste
¾ teaspoons Pasta Of Your Choice
description: Fra Diavolo is one of the tastiest Italian dishes. I’ve been making this recipe with shrimp for many years but the combination of scallops, shrimp and clams make this version extra special!

name: Strawberry-Infused Chocolate Truffles
ingredients:
½ cups Heavy Cream
¼ cups Butter
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
8 ounces, weight Good Quality Bittersweet Chocolate, Broken In Squares
¼ cups Strawberry Jam, Melted
¼ cups Baking Cocoa
description: Give your sweetie a sweet gift this Valentine’s Day with this strawberry-infused chocolate truffle recipe.

name: Mix-In Muffins
ingredients:
1-½ cup Flour
⅓ cups Sugar
1-½ teaspoon Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Baking Soda
¼ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Nutmeg Or Cinnamon, Depending On Muffin Variety
½ cups Butter Or Coconut Oil, Melted
2  Eggs
1 cup Sour Cream
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1 cup To 2 Cups Your Chosen Add-ins (See Suggestions In Recipe)
description: Great base mix to add in whatever your heart desires. My favorite is bananas, chocolate chips and coconut!

name: Lemon & Poppy Seed Mini Madeleines
ingredients:
¾ cups All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Sea Salt
2  Large Eggs
⅓ cups White Sugar
1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar
1-⅓ Tablespoon Honey
1 Tablespoon Lemon Zest
1 teaspoon Water
1 Tablespoon Poppy Seeds
6 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, melted
description: Madeleines are an amazing little snack I used to have all the time as a child in Paris. They’re easy to make, incredibly tasty (seriously, try eating just one!), and in my opinion, carry an elegance that’s lost when serving most alternatives—for example, cupcakes.

name: Oude Cranberry Cocktail
ingredients:
2 teaspoons Cranberry Juice
½ teaspoons White Sugar
2 dashes Angostura Bitters
2 ounces, fluid Oude Genever Gin (I Used Diep9)
description: Refreshing, bright and ever so earthy, this cocktail is an easy light-flavored drink for when you’re looking for something gentle and tasty.

name: Chewy Almond Cookies
ingredients:
1 cup Almonds, Toasted
1-½ cup All-purpose Flour
½ teaspoons Baking Soda

1 teaspoon Cornstarch

⅓ cups White Sugar
1 whole Egg, Room Temperature
1 whole Egg Yolk, Room Temperature
1-½ teaspoon Almond Extract
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
description: These cookies are simple to make and full of toasted almond flavor!

name: Chakalaka
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons Coconut Oil
1 whole Large Onion, Chopped
2 cloves Garlic, Minced
2 whole Green Chilis, Diced
1 cup Green String Beans
1 whole Green Bell Pepper, Diced
2 cups Grated Carrots
1 teaspoon White Pepper

4 sprigs Fresh Thyme, Chopped (optional But Recommended)

2 whole Large Tomatoes, Diced
2 Tablespoons Tomato Puree
15 ounces, weight Cooked Cannellini Beans
description: A dish truly representative of the South African “rainbow cuisine,” chakalaka really does it all. It is widely used as a spicy condiment but is also known to be a delicious standalone meal with some mealiepap!

name: Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil
½ cups Roughly Chopped
2 cloves Garlic, Roughly Chopped
½ cups Roasted Red Peppers, Roughly Sliced
1 can (14 1/2 Oz. Size) Fire Roasted Tomatoes

¼ cups Heavy Cream

⅛ teaspoons Dried Oregano

⅛ teaspoons Pepper
1 pinch Salt
description: Super rich and creamy Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup. An easy weeknight meal that takes less than 30 minutes to make.

name: Moroccan Roasted Beet Salad with Almonds and Pomegranate Seeds
ingredients:
2 bunches Beets (about 8 Medium), Trimmed And Rinsed
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil

½ teaspoons Sea Salt, Plus More For Roasting Beets

description: Moroccan Roasted Beet Salad with Almonds and Pomegranate Seeds.

name: Harissa Hummus
ingredients:
1 can (15 Oz. Size) Garbanzo Beans

2 Tablespoons Tahini Paste

½ teaspoons Salt
description: This hummus gets an extra kick from the addition of harissa, a hot chili pepper paste. It is quick and simple to make, healthy, just a little bit spicy, and super delicious. Serve it with a bunch of veggies and pretzels.

name: 7-up Biscuits with Greek Yogurt
ingredients:
½ cups Melted Butter
2 cups Bisquick Or Another Baking Mix
½ cups Greek Yogurt
½ cups 7-up
description: Quick and easy, watching these light and fluffy biscuits rise while they’re baking is a pure joy!

name: Coconut Crusted Brioche French Toast
ingredients:
¾ cups FOR THE FRENCH TOAST:
2  Light Coconut Milk

name: Roasted Lemon Chicken with Wild Mushrooms
ingredients:
1 whole Chicken, Split In Half Lengthwise With Skin On
1 teaspoon Smoked Paprika
1 teaspoon Kosher Salt
1 teaspoon Fresh Ground Black Pepper
1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup Dry White Wine (sauvignon Blanc Or Pinot Grigio Works Great!)
1 whole Lemon, Juiced
15 cloves Garlic, Peeled
1 whole Lemon Thinly Sliced
1 cup Assorted Wild Mushrooms (mix Of Blue Or Yellow Oyster And Shiitake, If Available--or Substitute With Crimini Or White Button Mushrooms)

description: A whole chicken is split and slow-roasted on the bone, covered nearly halfway with a lemon and white wine bath. It is surrounded by generous amounts of wild mushrooms, fresh thyme, garlic cloves and lemon slices. It couldn’t be more tender, bright and flavorful. It’s nearly perfect.

name: Valentine Brownie Pops
ingredients:
3-½ ounces, weight FOR THE BROWNIES:

ingredients:
1 cup Blueberries

¾ cups Water
1 Tablespoon Maple Syrup Or Honey
description: A creamy, clean and easy vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free breakfast bowl that you’ll fall in love with.

name: Mexican Snowball Cookies
ingredients:

¼ cups Unsweetened Cocoa Powder

ingredients:

2 Tablespoons FOR THE ROSE-COLORED FROSTING:
description: Rose Bouquet Cake perfect for Valentine’s Day. This is a chocolate layered cake with vanilla buttercream frosting.

name: Lime Cream Frosting
ingredients:
1-¼ cup Heavy Cream

½ sticks Sweet Cream Butter
2 whole Limes, Zest And Juice
1-¼ cup Confectioners Sugar
description: Super delicious on a white sheet pan cake! My family loves this frosting. Great on cupcakes, too!

ingredients:
2-¼ cups Low Sodium Chicken Or Vegetable Broth

8 strips Hickory Smoked Bacon (cooked Until Crispy, Cut Into Pieces)
description: A scrumptious hot bowl of this chowder will fill that void on a cold night!

name: DIY Lavender Sugar
ingredients:
1-½ cup Raw Sugar (brown Unrefined Sugar)
2 sprigs Culinary Lavender (flower Buds Removed From Stem)
description: This is wonderful in baked goods and beverages or whatever sounds good.

name: Fiskefilet med Remoulade
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE REMOULADE:

4 sprigs Mustard
4 whole Fresh Parsley, Chopped
3 Tablespoons Cornichons, Very Finely Chopped
1 whole Apple Cider Vinegar

1 whole Apple, Grated (optional)
1 teaspoon Medium Carrot, Grated (optional)
1 teaspoon Coconut Sugar (optional)
¼ cups Capers (optional)
¼ cups FOR THE FISKEFILET:

8 leaves Flounder Fillets
description: One of the most famous types of Danish smorrebrod (open-faced sandwiches), this fiskefilet recipe makes healthy adjustments both to the fillet and to the corresponding remoulade sauce for a healthy, hearty traditional Danish snack!

name: Ropa Vieja
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon FOR THE MEAT:
2 pounds Olive Oil
2 cups Flank Steak, Cut Into 1/2 Inch Strips And Seasoned With Salt And Pepper
